body: The 2026-11-22 Phase-G review recorded T4 non_conformant and named v1-p6-2, v1-p6-4, v1-p6-5 and v1-p6-6. All four are resolved with named commits and tests; delivery contract v2 records the remediated scope and this change authorises the record.

impact.scope: no scope change; the coach loop's four findings are remediated and re-reviewed

title: Remediate T4's four Phase-G findings
